bools.comment: the nature - a race of birdlike humanoid creatures found in uninhabited mountain areas, though not far from settled lands (print capture p. 284)

bools.name: dktOriginalInhabitants
bools.comment: the lore - many people believe they were the original inhabitants of the land before the arrival of humans (print capture p. 284)

bools.name: dktPushedIntoMountains
bools.comment: the displacement - once the humans arrived with their organization and culture, the tengu were pushed deeper and deeper into the mountains (print capture p. 284)

bools.comment: the haunts - they now dwell in forest glades, meadows, and on the banks of streams and ponds (print capture p. 284)

bools.name: dktNoVillages

bools.name: dktTwoTypes

bools.comment: the crow build - a humanoid two to three feet tall with the head and beak of a crow (print capture p. 284)

bools.name: dktCrowFeatheredWings
bools.comment: the crow wings - feathered wings sprout from between their shoulder blades (print capture p. 284)

bools.name: dktCrowEvilMalicious
bools.comment: the crow temper - evil and malicious, seeking to cause harm to all humans who stray into their territory (print capture p. 284)

bools.name: dktCrowKatanaWakizashi
bools.comment: the crow weapons - they fight with katana and wakizashi (print capture p. 284)

bools.name: dktCrowSpeaksThree
bools.comment: the crow languages - the language of tengu, that of animals, and the human language of the area (print capture p. 284)

bools.name: dktCrowPerfectMimicry
bools.comment: the crow mimicry - able to perfectly mimic voices of those they have heard (print capture p. 284)

bools.name: dktCrowPolymorphAndShout
bools.comment: the crow spells - able to use polymorph self and shout spells three times per day (print capture p. 284)

bools.name: dktCrowLowerStatus

bools.name: dktHumThreeToFourFeet
bools.comment: the humanoid build - stand from three to four feet tall (print capture p. 284)

bools.name: dktHumLongNoses
bools.comment: the humanoid look - normal human faces except that the skin is red or blue and their noses are exceptionally long (print capture p. 284)

bools.name: dktHumStuntedWings
bools.comment: the humanoid wings - they may or may not have stunted feathered wings on their backs, growing between their shoulder blades (print capture p. 284)

bools.name: dktHumThricePowers
bools.comment: the humanoid thrice powers - polymorph self, shout, and phantasmal force three times per day (print capture p. 284)

bools.name: dktHumInvisibleAtWill
bools.comment: the humanoid invisibility - become invisible at will (print capture p. 284)

bools.name: dktHumWeeklyPowers
bools.comment: the humanoid weekly powers - reward or ancient curse once per week (print capture p. 284)

bools.name: dktHumMisdirectionPerTurn
bools.comment: the humanoid misdirection - use misdirection once per turn (print capture p. 284)

bools.name: dktHumGhostLightPerRound
bools.comment: the humanoid ghost light - use ghost light once per round (print capture p. 284)

bools.name: dktHumPerfectMimicry
bools.comment: the humanoid mimicry - they can mimic any human or animal sound perfectly (print capture p. 285)

bools.name: dktHumSpeaksThree
bools.comment: the humanoid languages - the language of their own kind, that of the local human population, and the languages of animals (print capture p. 285)

bools.name: dktHumShukenjaAndKensai
bools.comment: the humanoid dual ability - the spellcasting ability of a shukenja and the combat ability of a kensai, both of the same experience level as their hit dice (print capture p. 285)

bools.name: dktHumOneMartialStyle
bools.comment: the humanoid arts - they know one martial arts style with two to five special maneuvers in that style (print capture p. 285)

bools.name: dktHumFeatherFan
bools.comment: the humanoid fan - they always carry a fan made of brightly colored feathers (print capture p. 285)

bools.name: dktHumFanAsKatana
bools.comment: the folded fan - the fan has magical properties, allowing it to be used as a normal katana when folded (print capture p. 285)

bools.name: dktHumFanWindAndGrowth
bools.comment: the fanned fan - when fanned it can create a wind equal to a strong gale as per wind breath, cast a quickgrowth spell, or cause abnormal growth or shrinkage of a facial feature, the nose or ears most common (print capture p. 285)

bools.name: dktHumCruelTricks
bools.comment: the humanoid temper - while not evil, they are not overly fond of humans and often play cruel tricks upon humans (print capture p. 285)

bools.name: dktHumLikesSwordSpecialists
bools.comment: the humanoid liking - they have a liking for shukenja, wu jen, and kensai who specialize in the sword (print capture p. 285)

bools.name: dktHumTutorsKensai
bools.comment: the humanoid tutoring - on rare occasions they tutor a sword kensai, teaching him the secrets of their skill, which takes 1 to 3 months and earns the kensai 1,000 XP (print capture p. 285)

bools.name: dktSecretiveCapricious
bools.comment: the character - all tengu are extremely secretive and capricious (print capture p. 285)

bools.name: dktLittleKnown
bools.comment: the mystery - little is known about their way of life (print capture p. 285)

bools.name: dktFondOfSake
bools.comment: the bribe - quite fond of strong drink and can be bribed, appeased, or befriended with large offerings of sake (print capture p. 285)

bools.name: dktTasteForMusic
bools.comment: the music - they also have a taste for music, particularly that of the flute and drum (print capture p. 285)
